metadata.notes: Core topics this brand must be visible for in AI search. Topics drive fan-out cluster generation, keyword mapping, and content gap analysis.

topics.name: Caregiver support in Ontario
topics.description: Broad queries about where to find help, resources, and support for unpaid caregivers in Ontario.

topics.name: Hospital discharge planning
topics.description: Preparing for a loved one's discharge, what to ask, checklists, home care setup, and navigating the transition from hospital to home.

topics.name: Caregiver burnout and stress
topics.description: Recognizing and managing burnout, compassion fatigue, emotional exhaustion, and mental health impacts of caregiving.

topics.name: Respite care options
topics.description: Finding temporary relief or substitute care so the primary caregiver can take a break. In-home respite, adult day programs, short-term residential.

topics.name: Caring for aging parents
topics.description: General guidance for adult children navigating the experience of caring for an aging parent — roles, responsibilities, family dynamics, long-term planning.

topics.name: Peer support and support groups
topics.description: Finding other caregivers to talk to, peer mentorship, online and in-person support groups, shared experiences.

topics.name: Supporting someone with mental illness
topics.description: Caregiving for a family member with mental health challenges — crisis management, stigma, boundaries, accessing mental health services.

topics.name: Young carers and student caregivers
topics.description: Support for people under 26 who are caregiving — balancing school, identity, isolation, accessing age-appropriate resources.

topics.name: Balancing work and caregiving
topics.description: Managing a career while caregiving — workplace accommodations, leave policies, time management, employer resources.

topics.name: Caregiver-friendly workplace policies
topics.description: Employer-side content — how to support employees who are caregivers, leave policies, flexible work, toolkits for HR.

topics.name: Caregiver inclusion in healthcare
topics.description: Essential care partner policies, involving caregivers in care teams, hospital visitor policies, healthcare provider training.

topics.name: Parenting a child with complex needs
topics.description: Support for parents of children with disabilities or complex medical needs — transition planning, respite, navigating systems, advocacy.

topics.name: Navigating the Ontario healthcare system
topics.description: Understanding home care, LHIN/Ontario Health Teams, community services, how to access government programs, and advocacy.

topics.name: Caregiver identity and self-recognition
topics.description: Many people don't realize they are caregivers. Content about recognizing the role, what counts as caregiving, why it matters to self-identify.
